## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与变更后的行为

Explain the concrete problem and link the relevant issue or proposal.

## Scope and contract impact / 修改范围与契约影响

Describe affected modules, public interfaces, and unresolved design choices.

## Evidence / 验证证据

List checks actually run, their results, and anything unverified. For documentation-only changes, report the relevant link, example, and terminology review.

## Reviewer notes / 评审提示

Mention tradeoffs, known limitations, and follow-up work when relevant.
